Major League Baseball Featuring Ken Grif.name: Major League Baseball Featuring Ken Griffey Jr.
Major League Baseball Featuring Ken Grif.summary: Make your dreams of becoming a Major Leaguer a reality! Hit a grand slam, pitch a no-hitter, go for the cycle and steal home - all in the same game! If that's not enough, check out the real-time stat tracking in over 30 major categories. Improve your team by making the right trades and picking up the best free agents. Major League Baseball Featuring Ken Griffey Jr. is so real, every pitch counts!

Susume! Taisen Puzzle Dama - Toukon! Mar.name: Susume! Taisen Puzzle Dama: Toukon! Marutama Chou
Susume! Taisen Puzzle Dama - Toukon! Mar.summary: Susume! Taisen Puzzle Dama: Tōkon! Marutama Chō is a puzzle video game released in 1998 on the Nintendo 64 in Japan only. The game was developed and published by Konami. It is a port of the arcade and PlayStation game Susume! Taisen Puzzle-Dama (Let's Attack Crazy Cross), originally released in 1996, but also features characters and gameplay from the spin-off Taisen Tokkae-Dama.

Toon Panic.name: Toon Panic
Toon Panic.summary: Toon Panic was a multiplayer brawler / arcade fighting game for Nintendo 64, in development at Bottom Up. It was meant to be similar to Power Stone or Rakugaki ShowTime, but it was later cancelled because of bankruptcy of the studio.
